decisions.decision: When comparing XRP derivatives with BTC/ETH/SOL, preserve same-provider, same-cutoff observations and retain each asset's contract/venue scope. Do not average with other providers or infer notional positioning from account ratios.
decisions.reason: The 19:22 UTC Liqwall panel shows XRP OI/funding divergence from BTC within one provider snapshot; this is a candidate relative feature, not a validated predictor.

decisions.decision: Cross-asset comparisons enter the historical feature store only with point-in-time timestamps, identical observation cutoffs, and explicit contract coverage; target labels remain fixed-horizon and future-data-free.
decisions.reason: Asynchronous and coverage-mismatched data can create spurious relative-value signals.
